title: Battery Capacity Estimator (Least Squares)
text: 使用最小二乘算法的电池容量估计器，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Specify Current input as cell current(s)} 指定将电流输入端口指定为向量、{Least square algorithm} 指定最小二乘算法 Ordinary least、{SOC change detection threshold} 指定检测 SOC 变化的阈值、{Forgetting factor, gamma} 指定遗忘因子、{Variance of SOC, VarianceX} 指定 SOC 的方差 2e-4、{Variance of current measurement, VarianceY} 指定电流测量的方差 5e-7、{Scaling factor k in VarianceX=k^2*VarianceY} 指定缩放因子 k、{Algorithm data type} 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit，按实例取值。

ports.name: CellSOC
ports.summary: 电芯荷电状态，无量纲 scalar | vector

ports.name: InitialCellAH
ports.summary: 初始电芯容量，A*Hr scalar | vector

ports.name: CellAH
ports.summary: 估计的单体电池容量，A*Hr scalar | vector

params.name: Specify Current input as cell current(s)
params.values: 将电流输入端口指定为向量的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Least square algorithm
params.values: 最小二乘算法 Ordinary least squares (default) | Recursive total least squares | Approximate total least squares

params.name: SOC change detection threshold
params.values: 检测 SOC 变化的阈值 0.03 (default) | scalar in the range (0,1)

params.name: Forgetting factor, gamma
params.values: 遗忘因子 0.9 (default) | scalar in the range (0,1]

params.name: Variance of current measurement, VarianceY
params.values: 电流测量的方差 5e-7 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Scaling factor k in VarianceX=k^2*VarianceY
params.values: 缩放因子 k 10 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 1 (default) | 0 | -1 | positive integer

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
